title: Welcome to the Python Crash Course Section!

cues.en: Coming up next is that Python crash course lecture series.
cues.zh: 接下來是 Python 速成課系列。

cues.en: Keep in mind this course is designed for people with some program experience.
cues.zh: 記得，本課程是為具備一些程式設計經驗的人設計。

cues.en: If you feel like I need more of a background than the basics of programming you may want to check out of course that's geared more towards Python beginners.
cues.zh: 如果覺得還需要補充程式設計基礎，可能要先看看更適合 Python 初學者的課程。

cues.en: Thank you so much and I'll see you at the next lecture.
